title: 5 Red Velvet Joy K-dramas to watch, from “Tempted” to “One of a Kind Romance” - Hashtag Legend Hong Kong
text:

 By Tom Kao November 10, 2026 From performing on stage with Red Velvet to taking on leading roles in K-dramas, Joy has certainly explored different sides of her career over the years. Now, she's making her return to the small screen after four years with "One of a Kind Romance," a new romantic comedy opposite Kim Hyun-jin that premiered on November 9. While she's best known for her music, her acting career has taken her from lighthearted romances to emotional melodramas. Whether you're a longtime fan or just discovering her as an actress, here are five Joy K-dramas worth adding to your watchlist 
 One of a Kind Romance (2026)
 Joy's latest K-drama, One of a Kind Romance , sees her playing Gong Yu-il, a struggling job seeker who has given up on her dream of becoming a writer. Her life takes an unexpected turn when she keeps crossing paths with top actor Tak Mu-i (Kim Hyun-jin), who mistakenly believes she's stalking him. Things get even more interesting when she ends up becoming his manager. Little does she know, he's actually a huge fan of a novel she wrote years ago. As misunderstandings slowly give way to understanding, an unlikely romance begins to blossom.
 Once Upon a Small Town (2022)
 If you're looking for something sweet and easy to watch, Once Upon a Small Town might be just what you need. Joy plays Ahn Ja-young, a friendly police officer in a quiet countryside village who meets Han Ji-yul (Choo Young-woo), a Seoul veterinarian unexpectedly left in charge of his grandfather's rural clinic. As she helps him adjust to village life, the two gradually grow closer. But there's a little more to their story, as they share a forgotten childhood connection, while Ja-young's longtime best friend also happens to have feelings for her.

 Tempted (2018)
 Looking for something a little more dramatic? Tempted sees Joy starring opposite Woo Do-hwan in a romance full of secrets, manipulation and complicated feelings. She plays Eun Tae-hee, an independent university student who has lost faith in love after her parents' divorce. That begins to change when she meets the charming Kwon Si-hyun (Woo Do-hwan). What she doesn't realise is that he's only approaching her as part of a cruel bet with his wealthy friends. But as real feelings start to develop, the game becomes far more complicated than either expected.
 The Liar and His Lover (2017)
 Long before her latest romantic comedies, Joy made her leading-role acting debut in The Liar and His Lover . She plays Yoon So-rim, a talented high school student who dreams of becoming a singer and falls for Kang Han-gyul (Lee Hyun-woo), a gifted songwriter keeping his identity a secret. When So-rim and her friends get scouted by a music agency, their lives become increasingly intertwined, bringing plenty of romantic misunderstandings along the way. With its mix of first love, music and the struggles of the entertainment industry, it's a particularly fitting debut for the Red Velvet singer.
 The One and Only (2021)
 For a change of pace, The One and Only shows a more emotional side of Joy's acting. She plays Sung Mi-do, a popular social media influencer diagnosed with terminal lung cancer who hides her loneliness behind a glamorous online persona. At a hospice, she befriends two other terminally ill women, played by Ahn Eun-jin and Kang Ye-won. But their unexpected friendship takes a darker turn when the trio becomes caught up in a murder case. Beyond the mystery, the drama offers a moving look at friendship, love and making the most of the time they have left.
